name: You in your profile grid
what: You shrink into the middle tile of a 3x3 profile grid on a glass panel while eight of your reels pop into the tiles around you, one a frame; then a view count pops onto every tile, a ring lights round yours and your own count counts up; at the end you grow back to the full frame and the grid flies out with you.
origin: MotionLab's own build after a design in Vibha Ramprakash's claude-video-effects (MIT), 2026-10-28
motion: f0-f12 (0.4 s, expo-out) the video shrinks into the middle tile (the renderer's frame effect) and the grid shrinks with it from 4x, about the one point that stays still, so the hole and the video stay one piece; the 8 reels pop into their tiles one a frame in the order top, right, bottom, left, then the corners (f2-f9, from 0.82 with an overshoot, 7 f); their view counts pop one a frame (f14-f21, from 0.5, 6 f); f23 a ring in the accent colour lights round you (8 f, slow end) and your count pops (f24) and counts up to its number (f24-f48, slow end); in the hold the ring's glow breathes (40 f) and a band of light crosses the tiles (f54-f84, S-curve); the last 0.4 s (S-curve) you grow back to the full frame and the grid scales out with you, the ring and your count fading.

tracks.name: shrink
tracks.what: you shrink into the middle tile, the grid closes in round you

tracks.name: reels
tracks.what: eight reels pop into the tiles, one a frame

tracks.name: counts
tracks.what: the view counts pop onto the eight tiles, one a frame

tracks.name: ring
tracks.what: a ring lights round your tile

tracks.name: your count
tracks.what: your view count pops and counts up

tracks.name: sheen
tracks.what: a band of light crosses the tiles

tracks.name: grow back
tracks.what: you grow back to the full frame, the grid scales out with you

min_why: the grid builds, your count counts up and it is seen a moment before you grow back
